title: Seven-document real-source projection into cumulative JANUS Linear A IR hardening v1.2.1

D5_projection_template.source_parts: Use exactly the fixed two lineage parts from the frozen R3C-2B coverage result.
D5_projection_template.part_tokenization: Split each source part on literal hyphen into SIGN tokens while preserving the complete original part string on its SOURCE_WORD group as additive source_group_raw.
D5_projection_template.groups: Create exactly two separate SOURCE_WORD groups for the two source parts; never merge them.
D5_projection_template.boundary_witness: Preserve the exact intervening source transliteratedWords newline item as one SEPARATOR token with source_raw equal to the actual source string.
D5_projection_template.v1_1_extension: Present with empty continuation/conflict collections, satisfying cumulative profile inheritance.

D6_projection_template.source_label_layer: For every source transliteratedWords item containing substring *904, emit a LOGOGRAM_SOURCE_LABEL token preserving the full source word and source_reading_label '*904'.
D6_projection_template.encoded_glyph_layer: Emit one SIGN token per U+1066B occurrence in parsedInscription with source_raw equal to the glyph and source_sign_id A319.
D6_projection_template.disagreement: Emit one base SIGN_ID_CONFLICT disagreement joining the label-layer and glyph-layer token refs with status MECHANICALLY_LOCALIZED.
D6_projection_template.v1_2_1_extension: Present with an empty cross_boundary_continuations collection; v1.2.1 must not alter the conflict semantics.

provenance_requirements: Every projection references the exact source file SHA and byte length.
Every source-layer token/group/conflict/continuation has a provenance ref tied to the source document ID and exact source field/array index in source_record_id.
No source field is rewritten to make a hardening validator pass.
Every IR is sealed with the base v1.0 ir_sha256 algorithm after all cumulative extensions are present.

for_each_D5: claim view without v1.2.1 boundary policies fails
claim view with both frozen fail-closed boundary policies passes

decision_rule.REAL_7_DOCUMENT_PROJECTION_PASS: All seven source-derived projection IRs pass cumulative validation and their negative/positive scientific-view firewall canaries behave exactly as frozen.
decision_rule.PARTIAL_PROJECTION: At least one source-derived projection validates but not all seven.
decision_rule.PROJECTION_FAILED: No projection validates or a source symptom differs from the frozen coverage input.
